name: usage-band
description: Usage band above the prompt: limits, context, tokens, speed, cost, tools, churn, model, effort, folder, git, memory and timing

show5h.title: Usage band: 5-hour limit
show5h.description: Pill with the 5-hour window's usage, elapsed marker and reset countdown

show7d.title: Usage band: 7-day limit
show7d.description: Pill with the 7-day window's usage, elapsed marker and reset countdown

showSpendLimit.title: Usage band: spend limit
showSpendLimit.description: Pill for a gateway's spend limit, when the account reports one

showPace.title: Usage band: pace projection
showPace.description: On limit pills, where usage lands at reset if the current pace holds

showContext.title: Usage band: context window
showContext.description: Pill with the context window's fill

showCacheRead.title: Usage band: cache read tokens
showCacheRead.description: Input tokens served from the prompt cache

showCacheHit.title: Usage band: cache hit rate
showCacheHit.description: On the cache pill, the share of input served from the cache

showSpeed.title: Usage band: output speed
showSpeed.description: Tokens per second of the last response (hover for the average)

showCost.title: Usage band: session cost
showCost.description: Session cost at API list prices

showBurnRate.title: Usage band: cost per hour
showBurnRate.description: On the cost pill, the session's cost per hour so far

showTools.title: Usage band: tool calls
showTools.description: Pill with the number of tool calls (hover for the top tools)

showChurn.title: Usage band: lines changed
showChurn.description: Lines added and removed by Edit, MultiEdit and Write

showModel.title: Usage band: model
showModel.description: Pill with the model that answered last

showEffort.title: Usage band: thinking effort
showEffort.description: The thinking effort of the last request (low … max)

showFolder.title: Usage band: folder
showFolder.description: The working directory's name (hover for the full path)

showGit.title: Usage band: git branch
showGit.description: The current branch and how many files changed

showDuration.title: Usage band: session duration
showDuration.description: Pill with how long the session has run

showTurns.title: Usage band: turns
showTurns.description: Pill with the number of turns and the last turn's length

showInTerminal.title: Usage band: show in the terminal
showInTerminal.description: Off to show the band only in the desktop app (the status line already covers the terminal)

terminalStyle.title: Usage band: terminal style
terminalStyle.description: powerline: colored segments like a powerline status line; plain: colored text

nerdFont.title: Usage band: Nerd Font icons
nerdFont.description: Icons and rounded powerline caps from a Nerd Font; off for text labels

layout.title: Usage band: layout
layout.description: full: icons and bars; compact: text only

warnAt.title: Usage band: yellow from %
warnAt.description: Bars turn yellow at this percent

hotAt.title: Usage band: red from %
hotAt.description: Bars turn red at this percent

alerts.title: Usage band: limit alerts
alerts.description: A toast when a limit crosses the yellow or red threshold

refreshSeconds.title: Usage band: refresh every (s)
refreshSeconds.description: How often countdowns and totals refresh
